title: Optimized Quran Passage Retrieval Using an Expanded QA Dataset and Fine-Tuned Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the performance of various language models on Qur'anic passage retrieval. This involved assessing their ability to accurately retrieve relevant verses from the Holy Qur'an in response to questions posed in Modern Standard Arabic, thereby testing their knowledge and comprehension of this specific religious text.
findings: By expanding the training dataset from 251 to 1895 questions and fine-tuning several transformer models, the system's performance on Qur'an passage retrieval was significantly enhanced. The best model, AraBERT-base, improved its MAP@10 score by 63% (from 0.22 to 0.36) and its MRR score by 59% (from 0.37 to 0.59) compared to the baseline. The approach also tripled the success rate for handling 'no answer' questions, from 25% to 75%, demonstrating the effectiveness of dataset enrichment and model optimization for question-answering on a complex religious text.
